_comment: Assumption-free STRUCTURAL invariants for the FIFO flag/occupancy relationship. These hold in every state, so they prove on fifo.v and falsify on fifo_buggy.v with the yosys-sat backend (no reset assumption needed). Temporal overflow/underflow safety needs the sby backend (reset) and lives elsewhere.

properties.summary: full is asserted exactly when count == DEPTH (4)
properties.rationale: The full flag must match a full occupancy. The off-by-one bug breaks this.

properties.summary: empty is asserted exactly when count == 0
properties.rationale: The empty flag must match an empty occupancy.
Reachability witness for the full condition.
